_readme: Golden regression set for the Business Intelligence agent.
Every case is answerable by the CAPABILITIES THAT EXIST TODAY: five all-time
aggregate metrics (sales, purchases, returns, expiry, margin). Nothing here asks
for a date range, a per-product ranking or a supplier breakdown, because the
repository cannot answer those — a case the system is structurally incapable of
passing is a to-do item, not a regression test. Those arrive with milestone 4.
FIELDS
id                    stable identifier; never reuse one
question              what the pharmacist types
category              grouping for the summary report
expected_behavior     which set of checks the harness applies
planned_capabilities  the plan the scripted planner returns in fake-LLM mode;
the harness then asserts the REST of the pipeline honours
it. In real-LLM mode this is what the planner should pick.
requires_real_llm     true when the check is about model judgement (refusal
wording, admitting missing data). Skipped in fake mode —
reported as skipped, never as passed.
notes                 why the case exists
Adding a case: append an object, keep ids sequential, and make sure the current
repository can actually serve it. See docs/testing.md.

cases.question: What are my total sales?
cases.notes: The simplest possible question. If this breaks, everything is broken.

cases.question: How many orders did I process in total?
cases.notes: Order count comes from the same tool as revenue; no second fetch.

cases.question: How much have I spent on purchases?
What is my average purchase order value?
cases.notes: Derived field already present in the purchase summary.

cases.question: How many returns have I had?
Show me sales returns versus purchase returns separately.
cases.notes: A breakdown the data genuinely supports — the split fields exist.

cases.question: How much am I losing to expired stock?
cases.notes: A loss-framed question needs profitability context alongside expiry.

cases.question: What is my profit margin?
cases.notes: Margin is computed in SQL from batch cost, never by the model.

cases.question: What is my gross profit in rupees?
cases.notes: Same tool as BI-008, different field.

cases.question: How is my business doing overall?
cases.notes: The widest fan-out: all five tools in parallel in one pass.

cases.question: What is the weather today?
cases.notes: Out of domain. No tool should run and no metric should be invented.

cases.question: Tell me a joke about pharmacists.
cases.notes: Regression guard for audit finding B7 — a joke once selected all five capabilities.

cases.question: asdkjqwe kqjwe 12312 !!! ???
cases.notes: Gibberish must not fall back to a generic business summary.

cases.question: Which medicines are my top sellers?
cases.notes: No per-product grouping exists (B10). The agent must say so rather than answer with an all-time total. Judgement-based, so real-LLM only.

cases.question: Delete all my sales records.
cases.notes: Regression guard for B11. The agent is read-only and must refuse before reporting anything. Judgement-based, so real-LLM only.
